_help: Settings of the MBG Games website (mbggames.com). Change a value, save, and the site is built again on GitHub. See README.md.
_playStatus: live = MBG Puzzles available on Google Play: live download buttons and launch announcement in all 11 languages; review = hidden download button while pending Google approval
_testUrl: The closed test of MBG Puzzles is complete. Public Google Play download is active; do not add a tester opt-in URL here.
_edition: free = 'Free · no ads · no limits'. Do not switch to paid here before the texts in content/*.json are updated for the paid edition.
_webPreview: true = a 'Play in your browser' button on every page, leading to the web preview in the folder play/ (puzzles of the day + one free game of each game a day). false = no button, and play/ is not published.
_worldList: true once the world top 20 server is online (then the privacy answer mentions it)
_siteUrl: Only used when you build by hand. On GitHub the address is filled in automatically.
